title: REVER Ride Log Ride Distance Leaderboard
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rever:ride distance_km=*
| stats sum(distance_km) as total_value, avg(distance_km) as avg_value by ride_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks ride type values by total and average ride distance across REVER ride log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `distance_km` values for each REVER ride log event and review total and average ride distance by ride type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total ride distance.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which ride type shows the biggest ride distance numbers in your REVER ride log data.
